purpose: Direct-locator judicial-counterweight tranche: materialize five domestic courts from proposition-specific or official repository-retained review surfaces without converting adjudication, appeal availability or counter-evidence into generic institutional governance outcomes.
migrationRule: An institution counts as migrated only when its ABox record points to a dedicated institution dossier. Court decisions, appeal routes and constitutional-review activity remain proposition-specific evidence; judicial identity does not create ECL governance, Material Participation, blanket independence or generic effectiveness findings.
visualRule: Derived visuals display State context and the exact curated judicial proposition, then terminate at the institution identity boundary. State S context, adjudicative activity and remedial adjacency never propagate to the institution.
